include: The live bindings are the per-scope bindings the dispatcher registers (the bindings modules and registerBinding in the dispatcher); user shortcuts change what the dispatcher resolves.
DEFAULT_KEYMAP stays the frozen v1 table that api.shortcuts() returns to plugins; user changes do not modify it.
Chords are normalised to their one spelling before user bindings are stored or compared.
A conflict with an existing binding in the same scope is detected and resolved, since a chord has one binding per scope.
User shortcut choices are stored with the user's settings, not in the document file.
avoid: Writing user bindings into DEFAULT_KEYMAP, or making api.shortcuts() return the user's current table.
Assuming the dispatcher looks key presses up in DEFAULT_KEYMAP, so that changing that table changes what keys do.
Storing shortcut choices in the document file.
